explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to plants with prior OAI classifications and the shortage has been listed for 49 months

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows etomidate injection has been in shortage since 2022-10-05 across multiple manufacturers including Caplin Steriles, Eugia US LLC, Gland Pharma, Hikma Pharmaceuticals, Hospira, and Mylan Institutional.
As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 49 months.
Hospira's plant (FEI 1021343) received OAI classifications in 2010-01-19, 2011-06-17, and 2011-08-04, with a Warning Letter issued 2010-04-12.
Hikma Farmaceutica Portugal (FEI 3002807173) received an OAI classification on 2014-03-28 and a Warning Letter on 2014-10-21.
Recent inspections at both plants were classified VAI: Hospira on 2025-02-07 and Hikma Portugal on 2023-04-21.
The best option by rule is to transfer 34 units from Corvale Lakeside (22 days on hand) to Corvale East (7.6 days on hand, would reach 9 days).
An approved therapeutic interchange exists for the same product from Civica, Inc. (NDC 72572016010) as an alternate manufacturer, approved 2025-11-20.

Q-96e49e.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%etomidate%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%etomidate%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-239e23.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('4312e3c3-34de-4cb3-8abd-c24d24a4bea1', 'b7ed5bf8-ba75-44dc-8f81-96b4ad5766be', '98002094-f065-4b5f-963f-2c34b5241316') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-781f06.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%etomidate%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-ab7185.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%etomidate%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-023439.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%etomidate%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-69c962.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('hikma farmaceutica', 'hikma farmaceutica s a', 'hospira', 'hikma', 'civica') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%etomidate%' ORDER BY initiation_date
